tasks.label: Check Docker Status
tasks.command: docker image ls && docker ps -a

tasks.label: Check Docker Status2
tasks.command: docker image ls; docker ps -a

tasks.label: DockerCheck3
tasks.command: docker image ls | Out-File C:\Temp\imgs.txt -Encoding utf8 -Force; docker ps -a | Out-File C:\Temp\containers.txt -Encoding utf8 -Force; Write-Host 'DONE'

tasks.label: Start Prometheus MLflow
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; docker compose up -d prometheus; Write-Host '--- prometheus started ---'; docker compose up -d mlflow; Write-Host '--- mlflow started ---'; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}`t{{.Status}}`t{{.Ports}}'

tasks.label: DockerStatus4
tasks.command: docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}`t{{.Status}}`t{{.Ports}}' | Out-File C:\Temp\status.txt -Encoding utf8 -Force; Write-Host 'written'; Get-Content C:\Temp\status.txt

tasks.label: CheckImages5
tasks.command: docker image inspect grafana/grafana:10.4.2 --format '{{.Id}}' 2>&1; docker image inspect ghcr.io/mlflow/mlflow:v2.13.0 --format '{{.Id}}' 2>&1; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}`t{{.Status}}' | Out-File C:\Temp\status2.txt -Force -Encoding utf8; Write-Host 'DONE'; Get-Content C:\Temp\status2.txt

tasks.label: BuildMLflowStartPrometheus
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; Write-Host '=== Starting Prometheus ==='; docker compose up -d prometheus; $exit1 = $LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host "prometheus exit: $exit1"; Write-Host '=== Building MLflow image (pip install) ==='; docker compose build mlflow; $exit2 = $LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host "mlflow build exit: $exit2"; Write-Host '=== Done ==='

tasks.label: BuildMLflow2
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; docker compose build mlflow 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath 'C:\Temp\mlflow_build.txt' -Append; Write-Host "EXIT: $LASTEXITCODE"; Get-Content 'C:\Temp\mlflow_build.txt' | Select-Object -Last 10

tasks.label: RebuildBackendStartApi
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; Write-Host '=== Rebuilding xauusd-backend with infra packages ==='; docker compose build api 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath 'outputs\build_backend.log' -Append; $e=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host "Build exit: $e"; if ($e -eq 0) { Write-Host '=== Starting api service ==='; docker compose up -d api; } else { Write-Host 'BUILD FAILED - check outputs\build_backend.log' }

tasks.label: BuildApi
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; $env:DOCKER_BUILDKIT='1'; Write-Host '=== Building xauusd-api (from local xauusd-backend:latest) ==='; docker build -f Dockerfile.api -t xauusd-api:latest . 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath 'outputs\build_api.log' -Append; $e=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host "Build exit: $e"; if ($e -eq 0) { Write-Host 'SUCCESS - starting api...'; docker compose up -d api; Write-Host 'API started!'; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}`t{{.Status}}`t{{.Ports}}' } else { Write-Host 'FAILED'; Get-Content 'outputs\build_api.log' | Select-Object -Last 20 }

tasks.label: ApiImageBuild2026
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; Write-Host 'BUILD API START'; docker build -f Dockerfile.api -t xauusd-api:latest . 2>&1; Write-Host "EXIT $LASTEXITCODE"

tasks.label: CheckBuildStatus
tasks.command: docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}\t{{.Size}}\t{{.CreatedAt}}' | Sort-Object; Write-Host '---CONTAINERS---'; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'

tasks.label: StartGrafana
tasks.command: docker compose up -d grafana; Write-Host '---STATUS---'; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'

tasks.label: CheckStatus2026
tasks.command: docker images --format 'table {{.Repository}}\t{{.Tag}}\t{{.Size}}'; Write-Host '---CONTAINERS---'; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'

tasks.label: BuildApi2026b
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; Write-Host 'BUILD API START'; docker build -f Dockerfile.api -t xauusd-api:latest . 2>&1; Write-Host "EXIT $LASTEXITCODE"

tasks.label: CheckNewImages

tasks.label: StartApi2026
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; Write-Host 'STARTING API'; docker compose up -d api; Write-Host "EXIT $LASTEXITCODE"

tasks.label: BuildMlflow2026b
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; Write-Host 'BUILD MLFLOW START'; docker build -f Dockerfile.mlflow -t xauusd-mlflow:latest . 2>&1; Write-Host "EXIT $LASTEXITCODE"

tasks.label: CheckApiStatus
tasks.command: docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}' ; Write-Host '---'; docker inspect xauusd-api --format '{{.State.Status}} {{.State.Error}}'

tasks.label: StartMlflow2026
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; Write-Host 'STARTING MLFLOW'; docker compose up -d mlflow 2>&1; Write-Host "--- COMPOSE EXIT $LASTEXITCODE ---"; Start-Sleep 5; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'
